utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Dane, the repair drive’s really coming together—if you can swing by, we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, and bring anyone else who can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late catching up, but I can still help spread the word and pitch in when I get there—when and where is it again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s over at the usual lot by the community garden this afternoon, and we’d love to have you—please spread the word and send anyone with shingles, two working drills, or extra gloves our way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Nell—if we’ve got the list and we’re starting at 9 on Saturday at the community center lot, I’m set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I’d only heard Saturday morning, so 9 at the community center lot is good to know. Are folks still bringing tools and supplies too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s the plan—tools and basic supplies too, and we’ll keep the drop-off table by the east entrance so it stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can pitch in for the repair drive, but only between school drop-off and pickup—mid-morning into early afternoon works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, but can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and how we’re moving the heavy stuff before I count on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can’t confirm the tools myself, but I’ll be there mid-morning to early afternoon and can help coordinate once school drop-off’s done.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, hey Cleo — I’m still a little turned around on the repair drive, so if you’ve heard any update, can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need shingles for the roof, two working drills, and more gloves for the repair drive—if you can cover any of that, I’ll mark it on my list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks, Cleo. I can probably bring some gloves, but can you remind me if we’ve nailed down the day yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, 10 at the community lot with overflow on Maple is clear enough to share; I just want Vik to confirm who’s handling the heavy hauling so the morning doesn’t bottleneck.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ve been telling folks it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center lot, and I’ll keep repeating that while I check who’s taking the heavy hauling so the morning stays smooth.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that works for me—once you’ve got the heavy hauling covered, I’m comfortable helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hana, I’m hearing the repair drive’s really coming together—Friday after school pickup is a good time to drop off tools or spare parts, and they could still use spare screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—before I pass that along, can you confirm the exact drop-off location and whether screws and extension cords are definitely the supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d double-check the exact drop-off spot before passing it on, Hana, but from what I’ve been hearing spare screws and extension cords are still the main gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what time can you get to the repair drive, and how long can I count on you to stay?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can get there this morning as soon as we confirm whether it’s 9 or 10, and I should be able to stay a few hours if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps, but I need a firm commitment—can you be there at 9, and if so, how many hours exactly can I count on you for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start at the community center lot and head east from there—can you double-check the date and what supplies we’ve already got?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Saturday, and so far Gus is bringing the ladder, drills, tape measure, screwdrivers, and topped-off batteries, with extension cords if Cleo still needs them; Cleo’s also tracking gloves, tape, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—Saturday at the community center lot, then east. If Cleo still needs them, let’s make sure those extension cords get brought too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, I’ve got the repair drive starting at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance so it stays easy to track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Opal—it gives us a clean setup, and I’ll check with the other groups so we can fill in coverage and keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—once you’ve got coverage lined up, let me know if anything shifts from the community center lot first so I can update the route notes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning starts with the shed roof; Gus has the ladder and drills, and Rey’s chasing gloves. Rosa, can you help confirm what we still need for moving the heavier boards?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo—since the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, let’s keep the shed roof first and confirm two more people for the heavier boards.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—shed roof stays first, and I can still do Sunday if we lock in two more people for the heavy boards. I’ll check with Sam and Faye.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by and get things started for the repair drive, but I can only stay a little while today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps, thanks — we still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves, so even a short start would make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, I’ll get things set up and see if I can track down a drill and some gloves before I have to head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so keep me posted on the repair drive and I’ll pass along the note about screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do—I’m still set to swing by Saturday morning with the ladder, drills, tape measure, and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—sounds like we’re in good shape on tools, so just let me know if anything else comes up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can get there by 9 and stay till about 1, and I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, and tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Gus — I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ll let them know you’re bringing a drill too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll swing by a little early with the drill, screwdrivers, and tape measure, and I can toss in some extension cords too if that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking around for the extra drills and gloves, Hana, and if shingles are still the hard part I can chip in a little.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—before I count on that, can you confirm exactly how many drills and gloves we’ve actually got, and whether shingles are still on the open requests list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know for sure Gus can bring one drill and a couple sawhorses, and the last update I heard was that we still needed shingles, two working drills, and more gloves. I’m still checking quietly, so I can’t confirm final glove numbers yet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me; Gus has the ladder and drills, and we should start with the shed roof. Do we still need gloves or a tarp?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We should still check on gloves, and I don’t want to promise a tarp until it’s confirmed—Cleo’s keeping the supply list, so I’ll ask her what’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—please check with Cleo on gloves and the tarp, and I’ll keep Saturday morning focused on the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the list and the 9 a.m. Saturday start locked in, and we’ll tackle the leaking shed roof first. I’m still sorting parking and heavy hauling so everyone knows the plan before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m a bit late to all this, but I can still help spread the word once you’ve nailed down the parking and hauling details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane—I’ll send you the parking and hauling details as soon as I lock them in, then we can get the word out for 9 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep—we’re still collecting tools, screws, spare parts, plus gloves and tape, and I’m checking with the other groups now so I can lock in the weekend details for you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s definitely bringing tools and how the heavy items are getting moved before we call it set?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’m confirming tool counts with Mara and the other groups now, and I’m also lining up who can handle moving the heavy items before I call it set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Community center lot first, then head east from there—can you double-check the date and what supplies we’ve already got?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the route starting at the community center lot, then east, and I’ll double-check the date now; so far I’ve got the drop-off table set for the east entrance and the bike station first at 10.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, keep me posted on the date—also check whether we’ve already got enough spare screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, from what I’m hearing the repair drive’s really coming together—Friday after school pickup is a good time to bring tools or spare parts by, and they could especially use spare screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—thanks, Tess. I’d only heard bits and pieces, so I’ll try to bring some screws and an extension cord by Friday after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be perfect, Nell—folks have been dropping things off steadily, and it sounds like every bit is helping the drive shape up nicely for Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what hours are you actually free for the repair drive today, and how many open requests on Maple and Cedar can you help verify?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so I’m not free just yet, but keep me posted on the repair drive and I can help verify Maple and Cedar requests once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need a real window, Ira—what time will you be back, and how many Maple and Cedar requests can I count on you to verify once you are?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oren, I’m spreading the word fast—repair drive’s Saturday at the community shed by noon, and they still need shingles, two working drills, extra gloves, screws, and extension cords if you know anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. I’ll head by the community shed around noon and ask around for drills, gloves, screws, and extension cords, assuming I don’t mix the list up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Oren—Saturday at the community shed by noon, and if you hear of anyone with shingles or a working drill, send them our way too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli—that’s exactly the right place to start; check the basic tools and supplies first, and then let me know what we’re missing before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll check the basic tools and supplies now and let you know what’s missing before I go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli—thank you; even a quick list before you head out will help me keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can be there mid-morning through early afternoon, as long as I’m clear for school pickup. If that helps, I can count on those hours for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps, Faye — if we post one clear start time and keep the drop-off at the east entrance, your mid-morning to early afternoon window should fit in nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—that window works for me, and the east entrance will make it easier to get in and out before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still locking down the last details, but yes—we’re on for this weekend and still collecting tools, screws, spare parts, gloves, and tape while I confirm coverage with the other groups.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ve got the ladder and tarps covered, and we’re still set to start with the leaking shed roof at 9 on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that’s still the plan as far as I know—9 on Saturday at the leaking shed roof, and I’ll send you a quick update as soon as I finish confirming the last details with the other groups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep—repair drive’s still on, parking lot Saturday from 10 to 2, and I’ll keep you posted if I hear any progress.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—I’m still out running errands, so just shoot me a quick update if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it, Ira—I’ll send a quick note if anything shifts, assuming I don’t lose track of it first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Faye—are they still collecting tools and supplies for the repair drive, and do you know when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, they’re still collecting supplies, and I’ve heard they still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves. I’m planning around school drop-off and pickup, so mid-morning to early afternoon is the window I can count on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot—I’d heard they were still collecting, but not what they still needed. Do you know if they’re actually starting this weekend, or should I check with Quinn or Jules?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s alright, Dane—I’ll start setting a few things out when I get there, but I can only stay a little while today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli—I’ll come by as soon as I can, even if I’m a bit late. Can you remind me of the time and place so I head to the right spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s Saturday morning at the usual spot by the community shed, and I’ll get a few things started there. No rush—just come by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, let’s set one public start time at 9 at the community center lot, with parking by the east entrance so folks know exactly where to go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools there by 9, and who’s handling the heavy stuff before we lock that in?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it straightforward: I’ll be there by 9, and Dane said he’d head over just before then, but we should name one person for the heavy stuff before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there Saturday morning with the ladder, drills, tape measure, and screwdrivers, and I can stay a good chunk of the day.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—that should cover a lot. Start at the community center lot first, and can you bring any spare screws or an extension cord too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can bring an extension cord and I’ll dig around for some spare screws before I head to the community center lot Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard we still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves, and Gus can bring one drill with sawhorses. I’m still checking quietly on the rest and can help chip in for shingles if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Rey—thanks for jumping in; if Gus brings that drill and sawhorses, I’ll keep spreading the word for shingles, one more working drill, and extra gloves, and tell folks to come by the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—if you hear of anyone with a spare drill or gloves, let me know, and I’ll keep asking around about shingles too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning still works on my end; if Gus brings the ladder and drills and Cleo has the gloves, we’re set for the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, then we’ll start Saturday morning at the community center lot and keep the drop-off table by the east entrance so I can track everything cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll be there Saturday morning and point folks to the east entrance when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If we’re telling people anything, I’m sticking with 10 at the community lot by the tool shed and overflow on Maple until the hauling and work list are actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s not send that yet, Pia—the repair drive was moved to Sunday at the community center, and I want us sharing the same update while I firm up the work list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, I’ll hold off, but once it’s final I need one public start time, the exact parking setup, and who’s handling hauling before I help spread it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah — it’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been telling everyone so it sticks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, Saturday, right — thanks for keeping me straight on it. I’d probably have missed that if you hadn’t been telling everybody.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Exactly — this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’m still reminding folks so everyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—can you commit to 9 to 1 for verifying and tracking supplies, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can commit to 9 to 1, and I’ll handle verifying requests while keeping the supply list updated.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—that’s firm, then. Are the Maple and Cedar counts going to be confirmed before the drive starts?
